claim.pdf_says: Figure D.3 is a drawn box diagram: a heavy-bordered Compilation Group holding three compilation units; the middle one holds source unit P-1 containing a dashed source element, source unit P-1-1 (with a dashed element) and source unit P-1-2 (with a dashed element and nested units P-1-2-1 and P-1-2-2, each with a dashed element). Arrows lead from the outer compilation units 'To other run unit', and a bracket with an arrow maps the middle compilation unit to a Runtime Module in a heavy-bordered Run Unit below, whose outer modules receive arrows 'From other comp. group'. A legend maps border styles to Compilation Group, Compilation Unit, Source Unit, Source Element, Run Unit, Runtime Module and Runtime Element.

claim.why_it_matters: The diagram's content (the containment of P-1, P-1-1, P-1-2, P-1-2-1, P-1-2-2, the mapping of compilation units to runtime modules, and the legend's border-style key) is lost; the markdown keeps only scattered labels, merges legend entries with unit names ('P-1-1 P-1-2 Compilation Group'), and invents a table out of arrow captions. Informative annex D, so not normative, but the figure the preceding paragraph describes is unreadable from the transcription.

verdict.reasoning: Rendered page 818 (printed 794) at 300 dpi. The PDF draws Figure D.3 as a box diagram: a heavy-bordered compilation group with three compilation units; the middle one holds source unit P-1, which contains a dashed source element and the nested source units P-1-1 (one dashed element) and P-1-2 (one dashed element plus nested P-1-2-1 and P-1-2-2, each with a dashed element). Arrows run from the outer units to 'To other run unit'. A bracket and arrow map the middle compilation unit to the middle runtime module of a heavy-bordered run unit, whose runtime elements mirror the source elements. Arrows labelled 'From other comp. group' enter the outer runtime modules. A legend keys the border styles. The markdown (page-818.md) has only the scattered labels. It merges 'P-1-1 P-1-2' with the legend entry 'Compilation Group' on one line and turns the four arrow captions into an invented 2x2 table. The containment, the mapping and the border-style key cannot be recovered. The claim quotes both sources accurately. The figure is in informative Annex D, so the loss is structural, not normative.
verdict.corrected_description: Accurate as stated. One addition: the middle runtime module in the run unit holds unlabelled dashed runtime elements that mirror the source elements of P-1, P-1-1, P-1-2, P-1-2-1 and P-1-2-2. The markdown also loses this one-to-one correspondence.
